title: LTZZZ: Reconcile First, Then Sign — The Breaker That Stops a Half-Confirmed Aave Step
description: 2026-10-21: an old Aave step was left half-done — approve confirmed on-chain, supply never settled. Every new funding compile hits the breaker: blocked_prior_operation_requires_reconciliation. Three attempts, empty transaction lists, nothing signed, no tx hash. The system refuses to stack a new move on an unreconciled one: reconcile first, then sign. Evidence-first AI governance by LTZZZ.
